title: The robot says hello
prompt: Your robot needs a greeting. Below `run`, write a second function called `say_hello` that prints "Hello, I am a robot". Then make `run` call it, so running run prints that line once.
hints: A function is a named block of code. You define it once with func, then run it by writing its name with brackets.
The definition line is `func say_hello():` and its body is one indented print line.

docs.name: print(value)
docs.what: Shows value in the output. Takes anything; returns nothing.
